bullets.text: Sweden Embraces Cash Again — After years of promoting a cashless society, Sweden is now prioritising cash resilience amid cybersecurity and network disruption concerns, impacting consumers and fintech firms alike.

FCA Supports Innovative Firms — The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has launched a Scale-up Unit to assist five fast-growing fintech firms, enhancing their ability to navigate regulations and innovate.
AI Adoption in Banking — HSBC's appointment of a Chief AI Officer highlights the shift in banking towards integrating artificial intelligence, focusing on workforce readiness and skills development.

New API Simplifies Compliance — The FCA has introduced an Application Programming Interface (API) for its Handbook, making it easier for firms to comply with regulations and access necessary information.
AI Optimises ATM Cash Management — Banks are using artificial intelligence to improve cash forecasting for ATMs, potentially reducing cash demand by up to 40%, benefiting both banks and consumers.
